intent: To demonstrate that transportation is the primary source of greenhouse gas emissions in the United States.

units.meaning: Transportation is the largest source, accounting for 28% of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions.

basis.note: Value parsed from the printed label 28%.

accepted_routes: Transportation is the largest source at 28%.
Transportation leads with 28% of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions.
The biggest slice is Transportation, at 28%.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Transportation must be visibly the largest wedge and be labeled 28%.
units.temporal_anchor: The clause 'transportation is the single biggest way...'
units.reviewer_question: Is it required to state both the top ranking and the 28% share, or is showing Transportation as the largest slice sufficient?

optional_valid: The other printed sector labels are Electricity 23%, Industry 22%, Commercial and residential 12%, and Agriculture 10%.
All non-transportation sectors together account for 67%.
unsupported_to_avoid: Do not claim Transportation is a majority (>50%); its printed share is 28%.
Do not use the earlier estimate 28% in place of the printed 28% label.
Do not claim an exact 100% total: the five printed shares sum to 95%.
notes: All five values now come directly from printed labels and sum to 95%. The table does not invent an unshown remainder.
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only

trim.reason: U2–U5 不是 intent 必须承担的命题，按人工审核意见移除
